full_page.content:
1943, September 22
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey. C. F.M. Cap.
St. Bonaventure s Monastery 1740 Mt. Elliott Avenue Detroit, Michigan Sept. 22, 1943
Miss Muriel Krausman 14595 Philomene Allen Park, Mich. Many thanks -for favor-noted.
Dear Miss Krausman: -
God bless you and yours. I hope you keep well and shake off a little more of that worry of yours. Instead, just offer that whole affair to our dear Lord every time you think of it and beg our dear Bl. Mother to help guide things for the best. God bless you again and sleep in confidence.
Sincerely yours in +0
Fr. Solanus
over
1943September 23
God bless you Miss Krausman.
I had hardly sealed your letter when your special walked in. . Many Thanks. . As said above try and keep courage. Every time you think of your troubles raise your heart with a little sigh.
"God help us!" including all humanity
Praised be Jesus Christ!
Yours sincerely,
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
